items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: with Keter Betts on Bass and Jackie Williams on drums, Junior and myself

ctx.x: I didn’t know you worked with Junior Mance. He’s one of my favorites. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -2-

Oh, yeah. I work a lot with Junior Mance. We have a new record coming out in the next couple of weeks on Chiaroscuro that we recorded on the Norway, with Keter Betts on Bass and Jackie Williams on drums, Junior and myself. And it turned out very good you know. They just kept recording us every night and we played I think four, maybe five nights on the boat, and they recorded everything. And now they say they have enough stuff for two CDs. So we’ll see. One of them comes out in the next couple of weeks.
Did you happen to play a tune with him called “Harlem Lullaby?”
